conectar.wa_intro: You are about to connect your WhatsApp Business number to the CRM of {slug}. You will be asked to log in with Facebook and choose (or create) your WhatsApp Business account.
conectar.wa_ayuda: Important: once connected, that number can no longer be used with the regular WhatsApp app on your phone. Use a dedicated number, not the one you use every day.
conectar.wa_cancelado: You canceled the connection before finishing. You can try again whenever you want.
conectar.wa_error_meta: Meta returned an error while connecting your WhatsApp. Try again or let FrontyBack know.
conectar.wa_listo: Done! Your WhatsApp is now connected to the CRM.
conectar.wa_error_final: Your WhatsApp was connected on Meta, but there was a problem finishing it here: {mensaje}. Let FrontyBack know - they have already received a notice to complete it manually.
conectar.wa_pago_aviso:
One more step (optional): if you later turn on appointment reminders by WhatsApp (they are off by default, under Appointments → Reminders), keep in mind that Meta charges for messages a business sends outside the 24 hours after a customer's last message — the appointment confirmation and reminder fall under that rule. The rate depends on your country and is charged to the card you add here:
  1. Go to business.facebook.com/settings
  2. Accounts → Messaging accounts
  3. Choose the one with your number → Payment settings
  4. Add a card
What if I don't add one? If you turn on the WhatsApp reminder without a card on file, the message simply isn't sent — the appointment is still booked, nothing is lost. The email reminder, free and always available, doesn't depend on this step.

conectar.ma_elegi_texto: You have access to several pages - choose the one you use for the campaigns of {slug}.
conectar.ma_listo: Done! "{pagina}" is now connected. The leads from your instant forms will enter the CRM on their own.
